newsitem.title: FRANCE: Belgian group interested in French SFP film studio.
newsitem.headline: Belgian group interested in French SFP film studio.

text.p: Belgian audiovisual production house LBO Convoi has been given access to data rooms containing financial information on French film studio SFP which is being sold off by the French government, a source close to the talks told Reuters on Monday.

Up to now, French businessman Walter Butler has been the sole candidate for the Societe Francaise de Production (SFP) and has put in a 50 million franc bid, which is conditional on a 1.2 billion franc cash injection from the state.
The source said LBO Convoi "has access to the data rooms and is keeping very busy."
The entry of the Belgian group sparked speculation that Butler will submit a second offer for SFP, whose unions are hostile to his bid.
Butler declined to comment when called by Reuters.
The next SFP works meeting is due on October 10.
Butler has proposed a deep restructuring which would shed 667 out of a total 1,056 jobs at SFP, to turn the loss-making concern around.
Finance Ministry officials were not immediately available for comment.
